options.text: Can I kill the dragons up here?

steps.player: Can I kill the dragons up here?

steps.text: If the player has blue dragons as a slayer task:

steps.npc: I suppose that's okay since you've got a Slayer assignment. But when you've finished it, leave the rest for me!

steps.text: If the player does not have blue dragons as a slayer task:

steps.npc: Don't even think about it - these dragons up here are for me!
There's a Slayer Master in my family, so I don't stop people doing their Slayer assignments, but otherwise these dragons are for me, not you.
Dragon-slaying, of course. Do I look like one of those serfs who wanders around scavenging scales off the floor? I'm just having a rest now, before I get back to the fight.
My cousin Slieve built the access routes through this blue dragon lair. But she's only really interested in black dragons, not blue ones, so she said I could have this area for myself.

options.text: Why are you dressed like that?

steps.player: Why are you dressed like that?

steps.npc: It's hot in here with all the dragonfire.
I've got wizard boots on, see? What more would I want?

steps.player: Well, maybe you'd want something to help you fight the dragons? Wizard boots don't sound very useful.

steps.npc: They're useful enough for what I'm doing. Anyway, moving on...

when-attempting-to-kill-monsters-that-ar.npc: Oi, find yourself some other dragons - these are mine!
